sample_unit: unique prompts (9 base scenarios x 18 condition variants)
models_evaluated: eight LLMs with diverse training paradigms (names not reported in text)

links.outcome: Decision shift under emotional framing perturbations of rule-bound prompts across eight LLMs
links.effect: Negligible effect size (Cohen's h = 0.003) versus human biases (h in [0.3, 0.8]); immigration extension +0.8 percentage point shift within +/-3 pp ROPE; adversarial narrative pilot found no meaningful decision shift.
links.quote: we find a negligible effect size (Cohen's h = 0.003) compared to the substantial biases observed in analogous human contexts (h in [0.3, 0.8]), approximately two orders of magnitude smaller.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating LLM robustness to emotional framing perturbations in high-stakes decision-making tasks, including healthcare scenarios.
